item-seeds-poppy-desc: Tiny oil-rich seeds of the poppy plant. Sow them on farmland to raise a crop of narcotic poppies.
item-seedpod-desc: The dried bulbous capsule of the poppy. Scored and scraped, its latex can be ground down into raw opium.
item-opium-desc: A small pile of brownish-white powder produced by grinding harvested poppy seedpods.
item-morphine-desc: Opium refined with limewater into a pale, bitter powder. A potent painkiller that binds swiftly and leaves the user craving more.
item-morphine-solution-desc: Morphine dissolved in alcohol to form an unstable tincture. Further treatment with spirits coaxes it toward something far stronger.
item-heroin-desc: The final, devastating distillate of the poppy chain. A small taste brings euphoria beyond any other; its grip is absolute and ruinous.
item-coca-leaf-desc: A glossy green leaf chewed for its bitter, numbing vigor. It wards off hunger and fatigue in the high country, at a slow cost.
item-seeds-coca-desc: Hard reddish seeds of the coca shrub. Plant them to grow your own supply of leaves.
item-coca-vitae-desc: A fine white powder made by drying coca paste.
item-coca-leaf-ground-desc: Coca leaves ground to a coarse green meal in a quern. Seal it in a barrel with Aqua Vitae to draw out a paste.
item-coca-paste-desc: A pale beige paste produced by sealing ground coca leaves with Aqua Vitae. It dries into Cocaine.
syringe-help: Hold right-click to apply 0.1 L. Right-click an open vessel to refill, or sneak-right-click with a vessel in your off hand. Refill with the same liquid until empty.
item-syringe-empty-desc: Reusable quartz and metal syringe. Holds 1 litre of heroin or morphine solution (10 doses).
addict-greet: A gaunt figure sidles up, eyes darting. "Psst... you got any drugs? I'll pay well."
addict-trade-thanks: "Ha! You're an angel... here, more than we agreed." The addict presses coins into your hands, already eyeing your pack for more.
addict-overdose: The addict's eyes roll back. They crumple to the ground, still clutching their fix.
addict-robbed: The addict snatches what they can from your grip and swings at you before running off!
addict-mugged: "Should've had something for me!" The addict swings wildly and takes off.
addict-leaving: The addict pockets their fix, mumbles something that might be thanks, and shuffles off.
addict-busy-leaving: The addict waves you off. They've got what they came for.
overdose-warning:
High drug load
Next dose: {0}% overdose risk.
overdose-active:
Overdose — movement impaired
Stop dosing to recover.
overdose-severe:
Severe overdose — taking damage
Stop dosing to recover.
addict-sell-no-container: You have no container holding that.
addict-sell-none: You have none of that to sell.
addict-sold-doses-goods: Sold {0} doses for {1} rusty gears plus {2}.
addict-cant-afford: The addict turns out empty pockets. "I... I can't cover that. Not even with my stuff."
addict-afford-partial: They could only scrape together enough for {0}.
addict-trade-addict-wealth: Has {0} rusty gears, plus scavenged goods worth about {1} gears
addict-trade-pays-note: Pays in gears first, then makes up the rest with goods.
command-spawnaddict-desc: Spawn drug addict NPCs near you (for testing). Add "true" to prefer addicts you already know.
command-spawnaddict-noplayer: This command must be run by a player in the world.
bong-empty-tooltip: Combine with one Marijuana buds in a crafting grid to load.
bong-return-tooltip: After smoking, the empty Bong stays in this inventory slot. Load it again with Marijuana buds.
stoned-hud:
Stoned — {0}:{1} game hours
Movement -{2}% · +{3} HP/game minute
joint-tooltip:
Hold right-click for {0} seconds to smoke.
Stoned for 2 in-game hours. Base effects: movement -20%, healing +0.5 HP per game minute, hunger +25%, creature detection factor -25%. Tolerance reduces these effects. Smoking again refreshes the duration.
drug-tools-coca: Base tool effects for {0} game hour(s): stone/ore mining +{1}%, hunger -{2}%. Afterwards: {3} game hour(s) of movement -{4}% and a one-time {5} satiety cost. Tolerance reduces these effects. Taking more refreshes the active effect but does not cancel an existing crash.
drug-tools-opiate: Base tool effects for {0} game hour(s): bandage/poultice healing +{1}%, physical attack damage -{2}%, ranged accuracy stat -{3}%, creature detection factor +{4}%. Tolerance reduces these effects. Repeated doses refresh; combined opiates use the strongest damage protection.
command-addicts-desc: List the drug addicts who know you, and what word on the street says about you
addict-greet-known: {0} shuffles up with a crooked grin. "There you are. Got anything for me today?"
addict-rep-assault: {0} will remember that. Word of it will get around.
addict-rep-killed: You killed {0}. Word gets around: addicts will steer clear of you for a while.
addict-rep-regular-died: {0} died on your product. Your regulars are spooked; demand will be down for a few days.
addict-rep-customer-died: {0} died on your product. Demand will be down for a couple of days.
addict-rumour: {0} leans in: "Here, for being straight with me. I picked through {1} about {2} blocks {3} of here. Still stuff lying around."
addicts-heat: Word of your violence is going around (heat {0}); fewer addicts come by.
addicts-heat-stop: Word of your violence is going around; no addict will come near you for now.
addicts-demand-low: Demand is down after a death on your product ({0} more days).
